summary: Acer Aspire 5 15 laptop has been discussed for its specs and performance. It is recommended to consider the MSI GP65 with 10th gen i7 processor and 1660ti GPU for gaming laptops under $2000, while the Alienware M15 may have overheating issues. The Dell G3 and G5 models are also worth considering. For a more powerful laptop, the Asus Zephyrus G14 with Ryzen 9 4000 series CPU and RTX 2060 Max Q GPU is an option. Budget-friendly options include the Acer Nitro 5 or Dell G3/G5 models, while the MSI GP65 or Alienware M15 offer better performance and features for a higher price.
